tools.name: golden-painter-20261012.json
tools.description: Create gold material copies for explicitly selected renderer slots, preserve their textures and alpha, and record assignment with Undo. Supports reviewed shader properties; inspect the visible finish on the intended avatar before saving the scene.
requirements: Unity 2022.3; selected scene renderer and compatible shader properties.
limitations: Source preview. No completed use on the intended gold avatar.
Texture maps and shader-specific effects may override the visible tint; no automatic texture painting.
Creates material copies; does not save the scene or upload an avatar.
